title: Cozy 3br/2ba in the heart of Franklin, TN
description:
Our cozy home is nestled in Hillsboro Acres, only 3 miles from historic downtown Franklin and 20 minutes from Music Row.  It has brand new gourmet kitchen and enough room for your entire concert going clan to sleep comfortably.  Please note that this is our home. Our personal belongings are in the house.  If you’re looking for more of a Vrbo rental with empty closets and drawers, this is not the place for you.  Also note that we have a cottage in the back of our property that is also an Airbnb.

The space
We’re just a few minutes away from historic downtown Franklin and 20 minutes from Nashville.
